data.title: 八重神子 · 神樱月下的宫司花嫁
data.description: 【鸣神大社神樱参道·黄昏】八重神子穿着红白相间的花嫁和装，粉色长发沿着头纱落下，手中捧花像一册新书；她回眸时笑意从编辑部的戏谑变成神明才有的从容温柔。
data.action: 神樱参道捧书卷般的花束回眸，戏谑笑意变成从容温柔
data.lighting: pink twilight under lanterns and falling petals
data.promptProse: Yae Miko from Genshin Impact wears a red-and-white shrine bridal kimono with a translucent veil, gold cords and a sacred sakura bouquet. She pauses beneath the Sacred Sakura with a bouquet arranged like a freshly opened volume. Her pink hair and fox ears frame the veil as she turns toward the viewer, letting editorial mischief soften into an unhurried divine smile. pink twilight under lanterns and falling petals.
